qualification: Mapped categories have a declared source boundary; they are not guaranteed on every screen or client. Unmeasured categories have no current mapped boundary. Neither state grants collection permission or qualifies sensors, delivery, anonymity or a release.

action_coverage.qualification: Interface actions and reviewed source routes, including fixed variants. Missing interface mappings remain unmeasured even when their category has another owner. Declarations do not prove every screen, sensor or installed runtime; no private activity is inspected and no collection is authorized.

reasons.control_cli.configuration_preview: Preview or intermediate authorization steps do not establish a completed setup, import or sign-in.
reasons.control_cli.state_inspection: Discovery, configuration reads, polling and inspection of earlier outcomes are not new workflow uses.
reasons.control_cli.producer_transport: Substeps belong to the originating capture or source producer; measuring this transport would double-count and infer ownership.
reasons.control_cli.recovery_transport: Upload chunks and continuation/status calls belong to the enclosing recovery controller, not separate recoveries.
reasons.control_cli.session_maintenance: Credential refresh is background session maintenance, not a new sign-in.
reasons.native_commands.configuration_preview: Internal setup validation and secret previews are not product usage observations.
reasons.native_commands.state_inspection: Status, discovery and polling do not identify a new user workflow.
reasons.native_commands.recovery_transport: Inspecting, archiving or cancelling a recovery receipt does not repeat the original operation.
reasons.native_commands.privacy_control: Privacy controls are not measured. Explicit report inspection may stage already-permitted aggregates without sending them.
reasons.desktop_ipc.configuration_preview: Internal setup validation and secret previews are not product usage observations.
reasons.desktop_ipc.state_inspection: Status, discovery and polling do not identify a new user workflow.
reasons.desktop_ipc.recovery_transport: Inspecting, archiving or cancelling a recovery receipt does not repeat the original operation.
reasons.desktop_ipc.delegated_alias: The enclosing Studio action owns its service or vault transport; this bridge adds no second observation.
reasons.desktop_ipc.privacy_control: Privacy controls are not measured. Explicit report inspection may stage already-permitted aggregates without sending them.
reasons.desktop_ipc.authentication_transport: Cancelling credential acquisition belongs to its existing sign-in operation, without a separate usage observation.
reasons.desktop_ipc.automatic_connection: Restoring the remembered desktop connection or returning its active session is not a fresh explicit workspace action.
reasons.studio_actions.automatic_query: Automatic queries, polling and saved state do not own a new action.
reasons.studio_actions.continuation_transport: The enclosing operation owns its upload or continuation steps.
reasons.studio_actions.configuration_preview: Configuration previews do not establish a completed setup.
reasons.studio_actions.transport_helper: A transport helper does not own an additional user action.
reasons.studio_actions.generic_transport: Generic SDK requests have no inferred workflow or collection owner.
reasons.legacy_ui.automatic_query: Route loading, React Query refresh and state inspection do not own a new user action.
reasons.legacy_ui.external_application: Handing a link to Obsidian does not observe that application's use.
reasons.local_stdio.delegated_alias: The inner owned tool call contributes once; the alias does not add another observation.
reasons.local_stdio.lookup_or_preview: Catalogs, identity/status inspection and dry-run previews do not count as memory work.
reasons.local_stdio.privacy_controls: Privacy controls are not measured. Explicit report inspection may stage already-permitted aggregates without sending them.
reasons.headless_controls.control_secret: Generating or inspecting private keys is not product telemetry.
reasons.headless_controls.control_inspection: Capture status and configuration previews do not identify a new work operation.
reasons.host_updates.updater_poll: Scheduled current-version checks, progress messages and safe-restart readiness checks are not separate uses.
reasons.host_updates.updater_quit: Unfinished update observations are discarded on quit. No shutdown flush or inferred post-restart success.
reasons.host_updates.host_updater_unowned: Manual/API/library update calls do not acquire the standalone automatic watcher's owner or inherit a remote operator's telemetry choice.
